dex.entry: The snuffed final form of a proud ember-kin lineage — a tall hound whose once-brilliant coat is reduced to cracked obsidian shot through with dying ember veins. art.silhouette: Lean upright hound, obsidian-black body with orange-amber hairline cracks radiating from a dark chest hollow; ears still flame-tapered but dull copper; tail a dead cinder-stump; eyes a faint dying coal-glow.
